Nobody on earth has more than 17 years of experience securing a Bitcoin wallet. The world’s greatest living expert in self-custody hardware and software is, by the standard of every other craft, a beginner. You are closer to the front of this line in history than you think.

Every great inheritance of civilization began as a dangerous skill, fire burned its first keepers, sails drowned their first sailors, flight fell from the sky. Mastery is how we pay. Hacks of Bitcoin wallets are this century’s payment, and the gift is absolute property, forever.

Decades from now, they will not marvel that the bitcoin price went up. They will marvel that it stayed alive, through panic, through ridicule, through wallet hacks, the loss of founders, one block after another, without a single day’s pause.
